teaser: your homepage has 2 links with no readable name and 1 text element below the minimum contrast ratio
topIssue: Keyboard focus is not visible (3x, serious, WCAG 2.4.7)

findings.title: Keyboard focus is not visible
findings.fix: Do not remove the browser outline. Add a clear focus style, e.g. a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a5fb4; outline-offset: 2px; }.

findings.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
findings.fix: Make the clickable area at least 24×24px (padding counts), or add space around it.

examples.detail: Target has insufficient size (121.8px by 21.5px, should be at least 24px by 24px); Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 19px instead of at least 24px.

findings.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio reaches 4.5:1 (3:1 for text 24px+ or 18.66px+ bold). The exact colours and measured ratio are listed per element below; a free checker such as WebAIM's contrast checker shows a passing shade.

findings.title: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
findings.fix: Give each one a distinct aria-label (e.g. "Main menu", "Footer menu").

examples.detail: The landmark must have a unique aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title to make landmarks distinguishable

findings.title: Page should contain a level-one heading
findings.fix: Mark the page's main title as <h1>.
